lastCompletedStory.title: Route file-local, triage, and suggestions-promote wrappers through the shared helper with >1 MiB regression test

nextStoryContext: index.ts's _buildCreateIssueOpts (file-local) and dispatchTriage now both set spawnFn: realOnMainSpawnFn (imported from src/git/on-main.ts), replacing the field-by-field rebuild. src/commands/sidecar.ts's issueFileSpawnFn is now `const issueFileSpawnFn: IssueFileSpawnFn = realOnMainSpawnFn;` (same import), still feeding makeProductionFileSuggestionsFn's readBacklogFromMain call (~line 2704, was 2714 pre-edit). index.ts's realSuggestionsSpawnFn (~line 1997, backing cam suggestions promote/dismiss) was ALREADY correct (inline `{ ...opts, stdio: 'pipe' }` spread) and was left untouched -- do not re-touch it. Remaining known field-by-field site per US-001's handoff: src/release/post-merge.ts's makeRealIssueSpawnFn (the actual original CAM-307 bug site, feeding defaultCloseIssueFn/defaultAbandonIssueFn/defaultDemoteIssueFn via issue-specify.ts's readBacklogFromMain calls) is UNCHANGED -- that is US-003's scope (plus a >1 MiB ship auto-close regression test and a full consumer audit), not touched by US-002. New test test/issues/backlog-maxbuffer-regression.test.ts builds a real tmpdir git repo with a 25-file backlog (each padded to 50KB description, ~1.25 MB combined, sanity-asserted via a direct `git cat-file --batch` call to exceed 1.1 MiB) and proves both createLocalIssueOnMain and makeProductionFileSuggestionsFn throw ENOBUFS with a locally-defined buggy field-by-field spawnFn fixture and succeed with realOnMainSpawnFn -- mirror this repo-factory pattern (not a small ASCII fixture) for US-003's ship auto-close regression test.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Re-confirmed spawnSync's documented default maxBuffer (1024*1024) and that exceeding it terminates the child and throws an Error carrying the truncated result -- matches the ENOBUFS thrown by readBacklogFromMain in the new regression test's buggy-spawnFn assertions, and the success path once realOnMainSpawnFn forwards maxBuffer through.
